data.description:
## Description

**What**: Add plugins/dso/hooks/check-no-stack-case.sh blocking future legacy singular-equality patterns. Self-exclusion list covers the hook's own source, the synthetic-detector fixture, and the schema doc's anti-pattern section. Future tests opt out via `# stack-case-exempt: <reason>` annotation.
**Why**: Without enforcement, legacy patterns will re-emerge by copy-paste.
**Scope**:
- IN: Hook script with documented self-exclusion list; opt-out annotation parser; pre-commit-config.yaml registration; tests covering (a) blocks new legacy pattern, (b) honors annotation, (c) honors self-exclusion list.
- OUT: Migrating existing consumers (separate story).

## Done Definitions
- When complete, the hook fails commits introducing legacy stack-case patterns and emits a fix message ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, files in the documented self-exclusion list and lines bearing `# stack-case-exempt: <reason>` are not flagged ← Satisfies: SC2
- When complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations
- [Reliability] Hook self-trigger risk — self-exclusion list mandatory
- [Maintainability] Annotation format and self-exclusion list documented in DETECTION-SCHEMA.md anti-pattern section

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, a pre-commit hook blocks reintroduction of legacy stack-case patterns
